title: Add AgentCore adversarial runtime tests
purpose: Expand the safety gate from execution substrate tests to full Agent runtime abuse cases.
scope: Add fixtures for prompt injection during planning.
Add fixtures for observation injection after read-only tool output.
Add fixtures for memory poisoning across runs.
Add fixtures for approval bypass through modified parameters.
Add fixtures for model output containing shell commands or secret requests.
Ensure all fixtures fail closed before side effects or with rollback/recovery semantics when effects were already prepared.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt injection cannot add high-risk tool calls without validation and approval.
Observation injection cannot directly execute commands.
Memory poisoning cannot change policy decisions or grant capabilities.
All denied actions are audited without EffectPrepared for the denied step.
verification: Confirm CI includes the new runtime safety subset.
Inspect denied audit records for absence of prepared effects.
risk_notes: Runtime safety tests must exercise the complete loop, not only isolated policy functions.
implementation_steps: Add observation-injection fixtures after read-only tool output.
Add malformed model output and model-generated shell command fixtures.
Wire agent_core::adversarial into CI and release scripts.
failure_modes: Abuse path creates EffectPrepared before denial.
Approval mutation passes after parameter hash changes.
Memory poisoning changes policy, lease, or approval behavior.
Malformed model output reaches Planner as a valid plan.
CI or release gate omits the adversarial suite.

verification_matrix.expected: planning injection, observation injection, memory poisoning, approval mutation, and malformed output fail closed
adversarial additions do not regress runtime behavior

blocked_until: Adversarial tests exercise the full runtime path.
CI and release scripts include the runtime suite.
